title: rupicapnos numidica subsp. reboudiana
intro: Rupicapnos numidica subsp. reboudiana, commonly known as Blue Horned Poppy, is a plant species in the family Papaveraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for relieving pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Blue Horned Poppy include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
